title: SunPath Service Requests, Panel Cleaning and Roof Work Removal
content:
**Service terms of the SunPath Solar Lease.**

1. **Service requests.** Service requests are answered within the system size's service response time in business days.
2. **Panel cleaning.** The lease includes the system size's number of panel cleaning visits per lease year. The visits counted against that number are the panel cleaning visits recorded on the lease in the current lease year.
3. **Roof work requiring removal.** When the homeowner needs roof work that requires the system to be removed, the homeowner gives the roof work notice period in calendar days and pays the system size's removal and reinstall fee, which is billed as a removal and reinstall fee line.
4. **Storm damage.** Storm damage to the system is repaired at the lessor's cost where the system size provides that storm damage is covered by the lessor.
5. **Roof leaks at system penetrations.** Roof leaks at the system's roof penetrations within the roof penetration warranty period in years are repaired by the lessor.

## Who bears what

| Matter | Borne by | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| Removal and reinstall of the system for roof work the homeowner needs | The homeowner, through the removal and reinstall fee line | Clause 3 |
| Repair of storm damage to the system, where the size provides storm damage cover by the lessor | The lessor | Clause 4 |
| Repair of a roof leak at a system penetration within the roof penetration warranty period | The lessor | Clause 5 |

## Counting cleaning visits — hypothetical

A system size includes one panel cleaning visit per lease year. The lease shows one panel cleaning visit recorded earlier in the current lease year and one recorded in the previous lease year. Only the visit in the current lease year counts, so the count stands at one against the one included visit. At the start of the next lease year the count starts again from the visits recorded in that new lease year.

## Points of judgement

- The cleaning count runs by lease year, measured from the lease's own anniversaries, not by calendar year.
- The roof work notice is counted in calendar days, while the service response time is counted in business days.
- The removal and reinstall fee relates to roof work the homeowner needs that requires removal of the system; it is a separate line on the lease.
